features.text: Patient reported swelling in the ankles that did not subside even when lying down.
Patient experienced difficulty breathing at night, requiring propping up in bed to breathe.
Patient had a recent hospitalization for heart failure.
Patient mentioned experiencing shortness of breath and difficulty talking, leading to a call for emergency services.
Patient described an ambulance ride as an experience they would not want to repeat.
Patient consumes salt and vinegar potato chips daily, preferring brand-name products.
Patient is reluctant to give up potato chips despite potential health concerns.
Patient reports feeling better after hospitalization and increased physical activity.
Patient experienced near-incontinence, which they find unpleasant.
Patient is on additional blood pressure medication, which they are trying to manage.
Patient has a home blood pressure cuff but has not used it regularly.
Patient plans to use the blood pressure cuff daily and keep a log of readings.
Patient has not experienced shortness of breath or sleep issues since returning home.
Patient has not had chest pain recently.
